stem: Voltmarkt's blended CAC is €25 and paid social's CAC is €60. The board must decide whether to move budget into paid social. Which number should drive that decision?

options.text: Paid social's €60, since blended CAC also counts customers who cost no media
The blended €25, since it covers every channel and every cost in one figure
The midpoint of €42.50, since it weighs the channel and company views equally
Neither, since only ROAS can compare one channel with another channel
